title: go-tebanare configuration
description: Configuration of go-tebanare, read from `.gotebanare.yml` or `.gotebanare.yaml` at the repository root. See https://github.com/miyamo2/go-tebanare/blob/main/docs/configuration.md.
markdownDescription: Configuration of go-tebanare, read from `.gotebanare.yml` or `.gotebanare.yaml` at the repository root. See https://github.com/miyamo2/go-tebanare/blob/main/docs/configuration.md.

version.description: Version of the configuration format. Must be `1`.
version.markdownDescription: Version of the configuration format. Must be `1`.

include.description: Files to analyze, as doublestar globs relative to the repository root. The default, also used for an empty list, is `["**/*.go"]`.
include.markdownDescription: Files to analyze, as doublestar globs relative to the repository root. The default, also used for an empty list, is `["**/*.go"]`.

exclude.description: Files to skip even when `include` matches them.
exclude.markdownDescription: Files to skip even when `include` matches them.

presets.description: Built-in presets to enable. Listing a preset twice is an error.
presets.markdownDescription: Built-in presets to enable. Listing a preset twice is an error.

items.description: A preset name, or `name: settings` to change its settings.
items.markdownDescription: A preset name, or `name: settings` to change its settings.

anyOf.description: A preset with its default settings.
anyOf.markdownDescription: A preset with its default settings.

anyOf.description: A preset name as the only key, with its settings as the value.
anyOf.markdownDescription: A preset name as the only key, with its settings as the value.

getterSettings.description: Settings of the `getter` preset. Methods that only return a field of the receiver. Settings left out keep their defaults. See https://github.com/miyamo2/go-tebanare/blob/main/docs/presets.md#getter.
getterSettings.markdownDescription: Settings of the `getter` preset. Methods that only return a field of the receiver. Settings left out keep their defaults. See https://github.com/miyamo2/go-tebanare/blob/main/docs/presets.md#getter.

paths.description: Globs that limit the files this preset applies to, on top of `files.include` and `files.exclude`. Default: none.
paths.markdownDescription: Globs that limit the files this preset applies to, on top of `files.include` and `files.exclude`. Default: none.

exclude_paths.description: Globs of files this preset skips, on top of `files.exclude`. Default: none.
exclude_paths.markdownDescription: Globs of files this preset skips, on top of `files.exclude`. Default: none.

include_doc.description: Hide the doc comment together with the function. Default: true.
include_doc.markdownDescription: Hide the doc comment together with the function. Default: true.

max_depth.description: The maximum number of fields in the returned chain: with 1, `u.name` matches and `u.cfg.timeout` does not. Default: unlimited.
max_depth.markdownDescription: The maximum number of fields in the returned chain: with 1, `u.name` matches and `u.cfg.timeout` does not. Default: unlimited.

iferrSettings.description: Settings of the `iferr` preset. `if err != nil` blocks that return the error unchanged. Settings left out keep their defaults. See https://github.com/miyamo2/go-tebanare/blob/main/docs/presets.md#iferr.
iferrSettings.markdownDescription: Settings of the `iferr` preset. `if err != nil` blocks that return the error unchanged. Settings left out keep their defaults. See https://github.com/miyamo2/go-tebanare/blob/main/docs/presets.md#iferr.

paths.description: Globs that limit the files this preset applies to, on top of `files.include` and `files.exclude`. Default: none.
paths.markdownDescription: Globs that limit the files this preset applies to, on top of `files.include` and `files.exclude`. Default: none.

exclude_paths.description: Globs of files this preset skips, on top of `files.exclude`. Default: none.
exclude_paths.markdownDescription: Globs of files this preset skips, on top of `files.exclude`. Default: none.

names.description: Names of error variables, as globs matched against the whole name, where `*` matches any run of characters and `?` matches one. Default: [err].
names.markdownDescription: Names of error variables, as globs matched against the whole name, where `*` matches any run of characters and `?` matches one. Default: [err].

allow_comments.description: Hide the statement even when a comment is on the hidden lines. Default: false.
allow_comments.markdownDescription: Hide the statement even when a comment is on the hidden lines. Default: false.

init.description: How to treat if statements with an init statement: `exclude` keeps them visible; `fold-body` hides the lines from `return` to the closing brace and keeps the header line visible. Default: exclude.
init.markdownDescription: How to treat if statements with an init statement: `exclude` keeps them visible; `fold-body` hides the lines from `return` to the closing brace and keeps the header line visible. Default: exclude.

allow_bare_return.description: Also hide a bare return. Default: false.
allow_bare_return.markdownDescription: Also hide a bare return. Default: false.

allow_calls_in_results.description: Allow function calls in the results before the error; function literals and channel receives still do not match. Default: false.
allow_calls_in_results.markdownDescription: Allow function calls in the results before the error; function literals and channel receives still do not match. Default: false.

noopSettings.description: Settings of the `noop` preset. Methods that take no parameters, return nothing, and have an empty body. Settings left out keep their defaults. See https://github.com/miyamo2/go-tebanare/blob/main/docs/presets.md#noop.
noopSettings.markdownDescription: Settings of the `noop` preset. Methods that take no parameters, return nothing, and have an empty body. Settings left out keep their defaults. See https://github.com/miyamo2/go-tebanare/blob/main/docs/presets.md#noop.

paths.description: Globs that limit the files this preset applies to, on top of `files.include` and `files.exclude`. Default: none.
paths.markdownDescription: Globs that limit the files this preset applies to, on top of `files.include` and `files.exclude`. Default: none.

exclude_paths.description: Globs of files this preset skips, on top of `files.exclude`. Default: none.
exclude_paths.markdownDescription: Globs of files this preset skips, on top of `files.exclude`. Default: none.

include_doc.description: Hide the doc comment together with the function. Default: true.
include_doc.markdownDescription: Hide the doc comment together with the function. Default: true.

allow_comments.description: Hide the method even when a comment other than the doc comment is on its lines. Default: true.
allow_comments.markdownDescription: Hide the method even when a comment other than the doc comment is on its lines. Default: true.

include_functions.description: Also hide empty functions that are not methods, such as `func noop() {}`. Default: false.
include_functions.markdownDescription: Also hide empty functions that are not methods, such as `func noop() {}`. Default: false.
